title: Phone walks only the latest update per subject, and says how fresh it is after a long gap

requirements.text: A newer reply's update for a project replaces every older pending plain update for that project from earlier replies; an older one is never walked before a newer one for the same thing
requirements.check: WalkPlanTest: merge with older+newer updates for one project leaves only the newer

requirements.text: When the oldest pending item is more than an hour old, the arrival screen and each walked item show when it is as of (time and how long ago) and that the laptop was checked just now for anything newer
requirements.check: WalkPlanTest for the freshness line; eye: arrival screen on Pixel after a gap
